display_long_description:
Transform Your Home Into a living Dinosaur sanctuary!

Place one of twelve life-size dinosaurs directly into your own environment and watch as it animates and comes to life. You can guide, move, and interact with each creature—feeding them snacks, playing games, and triggering unique animations. Switch to X-ray mode at any time to reveal fully articulated skeletons for close study. Alongside the fun, immersive 3D spatial videos teach you about each species, making Dinosaur Land both an interactive playground and a living classroom.

Twelve Iconic Species

Meet Tyrannosaurus rex, Velociraptor, Triceratops, Spinosaurus, Stegosaurus, Therizinosaurus, Brachiosaurus, Ankylosaurus, Gallimimus, Dilophosaurus, Deinosuchus, and the towering Quetzalcoatlus.

[media]

Key Features

Feed & Play

Offer carefully curated prehistoric snacks and watch each dinosaur’s unique eating habits and playful reactions.

[media]

X-Ray Skeleton Mode
Toggle between lifelike creatures and scientifically accurate skeletal reconstructions, perfect for hands-on study.

Learning Mode

Activate narrated lessons and 3D spatial media for a deeper dive into prehistory:

3D Spatial Videos & Photos recreate ancient habitats around you.
